description: Adapting Stormwater Management for Coastal Floods is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management. Stormwater and floodplain managers and land use planners in coastal communities can use these tools to determine how their stormwater systems might be affected by coastal flooding. Understand - access engaging animations and background information on events that can cause coastal flooding. Learn how flooding can affect stormwater systems. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
